name: MageComp LikeIt
author: Magecomp LLP

sections.description:
MageComp LikeIt is a highly flexible and lightweight WordPress plug-in that will enable you to add Like, Share, and Favorite buttons on your WordPress website. Enhance engagement and user interactions by providing users with the ability to like posts, save favorites, and share pages across social networking websites.

This plugin supports various kinds of pages, such as blog posts, product pages, custom pages, category pages, tags, author archives, date archives, home pages, and search results pages. With the use of customizable buttons and social sharing options, you would be able to enhance the visibility and user interaction of your content.

No matter what kind of website you have, whether a blog, an e-commerce website, or anything else, you would be able to make it easy for your visitors to interact and share your website\’s content.

Features:

  • Add Like, Favourite, and Share buttons to your WordPress website.
  • Enhance user engagement through interactive content buttons.
  • Supports WordPress posts, pages, archives, homepage, search results, and WooCommerce products.
  • Show buttons automatically without changing the theme files.
  • Option to show and hide Like, Favorite, and Share buttons separately.
  • Configure separate display settings for each button type.
  • Set a custom title above the interaction buttons.
  • Choose the position of buttons on single blog posts.
  • Choose the position of buttons on WooCommerce product pages.
  • Buttons Displayed On: Individual blog posts, WordPress pages, archive pages, homepage/blog page, search result pages, WooCommerce product pages.
  • Choose from multiple Like button icon styles: Thumbs Up, Heart, Star, Arrow Up, and Check.
  • Built-in social sharing support for: Facebook, Twitter / X, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Telegram, Reddit, Pinterest, Tumblr, Email, SMS, and Copy Link.
  • Configure Share tooltip position: Top, Bottom, Left, Right
  • Display all interaction buttons using a single shortcode.
  • Display individual Like, Favourite, or Share button using shortcode.
  • Display logged-in user’s favourite posts/products using a dedicated shortcode.
  • One-click social sharing experience.
  • Copy the page URL with a single click.
  • Optional cleanup of plugin data during uninstall.

External services

This plugin uses external services to provide social sharing functionality:

  • WhatsApp: We use the WhatsApp API to allow users to share content via WhatsApp. This service receives the title and URL of the shared page when the user clicks the WhatsApp share button. This service is provided by WhatsApp LLC: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin bundles and uses the following third-party libraries:

  • Font Awesome Free: Used for rendering icons in the plugin interface.
    • License: SIL OFL 1.1 (fonts), MIT License (code)
    • Source: Font Awesome
sections.installation:
Install MageComp LikeIt. Once activated, a dedicated MageComp LikeIt menu will appear in your WordPress admin dashboard.

Choose where you want the interaction buttons to appear automatically. A custom title can also be added above the interaction block. Choose separate positions for blog posts and WooCommerce product pages. The Like, Favourite, and Share buttons can be enabled or disabled independently. Choose which social media sites you want to show in the Share section. Select the like button icon that complements your website\’s design.

Save Changes, and these buttons will start displaying on your desired pages automatically. Your site users will now like your posts and products with just one click. They can also save your favourite content and share your posts and pages on popular social media websites.
sections.faq:
1. What is MageComp LikeIt?

Like It By MageComp is a WordPress plugin that helps you display Like, Favourite, and Social Share buttons on your posts, pages, WooCommerce products, archives, homepage, and any other kind of page that you wish to. In this way, user engagement would be increased, and your content would get shared.

2. Can I enable only specific buttons?

Yes. These buttons can be enabled or disabled separately as per your requirements.

3. Can I display the buttons manually?

Yes. MageComp LikeIt offers shortcode options for displaying all buttons or specific buttons, such as Like, Favourite, and Share, on your site wherever you want.

4. Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes. This WordPress plugin is compatible with WooCommerce and will help you add buttons on the products page.

5. Will MageComp LikeIt affect my site speed?

No. This plugin is very lightweight and does not have an effect on the speed of your website.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Added Like, Favourite, and Share buttons.
  • Added support for WordPress posts, pages, archives, homepage, search results, and WooCommerce product pages.
  • Added customizable interaction section title.
  • Added option to enable or disable Like, Favourite, and Share buttons.
  • Added multiple Like button styles (Thumbs Up, Heart, Star, Arrow Up, and Check).
  • Added social sharing support for Facebook, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Telegram, Reddit, Pinterest, Tumblr, Email, SMS, and Copy Link.
  • Added configurable Share tooltip positions (Top, Bottom, Left, and Right).
  • Added shortcode support for displaying Like, Favourite, Share, and combined interaction buttons.
  • Added Favorites List shortcode for logged-in users.
  • Added uninstall cleanup option.
  • Optimized for performance and responsiveness.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce and most WordPress themes.
